## Testing & Quality Checklist

- [ ] Prompt tested with realistic input on at least one AI model (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.)
- [ ] Prompt does NOT encourage fabrication or fake metrics
- [ ] Placeholders follow the standard `[UPPERCASE_SNAKE_CASE]` format
- [ ] Markdown formatting checked and free of syntax errors
- [ ] Output structure is clearly defined
- [ ] No unrealistic guarantees ("guaranteed job", "100% interview rate")
